data.one_liner: A type-safe Firebase rules generator for Firestore, Storage, and Realtime Database
data.what_it_does: Generates Firebase security rules from type-safe Dart definitions. Provides custom lint rules to catch issues before deployment and mimics native syntax for easy migration.
use_when: You want type-safe access to your data model when writing Firebase security rules
You want code completion and compile-time checks for your rules language
avoid_when: You prefer writing native Firebase security rules directly in JavaScript-like syntax
You are not using Dart for defining your security rules
strengths: Type-safe access to your data model
Code completion for the rules language
Custom lint rules to catch issues before deployment
weaknesses: Early in development and subject to breaking changes
Realtime Database rules are not fully type-safe
data.setup_notes: Requires build_runner and custom_lint plugins in dev_dependencies and an analysis_options.yaml configuration.
